{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''captain''' of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Dismay]]'' once intended to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] [[Praleena Pring]], the daughter of Imperial [[Consul-General]] [[Dandamont Pring]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. However, Praleena, who did not wish to marry the smug [[Captain/Legends|captain]].

Pring planned to announce the engangement during one of his opulent parties, with plans for her to leave for the ''Dismay'' the next day for the wedding. The Star Destroyer was in Bothawui's orbit and its officers attented the party. When Pring ordered the orchestra to stop, the Captain made his way to the stage for the announcement. On his way he tapped a stranger on the shoulder to get past them; he never learned that it was an [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel]] [[operative]] who attempted to invite Praleena to defect.

Indeed, the young Pring had no desire for such a wedding. Thanks to the operatives, she defied her [[Parent/Legends|father]] and left with her [[Unidentified Imperial defector|lover]]. While the Captain did not learn that Pring defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], he was not happy with the development. The Consul-General dismissed the incident as young love, claiming that his daughter would return once she thought things through.
